syntheticDecisions: The original line bases, China freight, native refund amounts and participant distribution are synthetic, not recovered production data.

Low-basis refunds belong to Pessoa A (2 CNY minor per historical BRL cent); high-basis shared refunds belong to B/C/D (1:1). These captured synthetic pairs deliberately exercise mixed FIFO and explicit advances without market conversion.
The toy refund has a synthetic native amount of 2767. Other non-shared credits belong to D and are not consumed.
Promotional credits of 229 and 114 CNY minor have zero BRL basis. The second bonus is an explicit test construction.
Eight paid corrections keep the same financial amounts and change descriptive metadata. Every correction uses the real compensating service.
Individual reference values are comparison data, not forced targets. The report must display actual values and signed differences.
